system.description:
• Effect: At-will ranged cantrip (60ft range). The target makes a Reflex save (DC = 10 + half your Warlock level (minimum 1) + Cha modifier), taking force damage on a failure or half on a success. No slot required.
  • Damage scales: 1d6 at 1st, 1d8 at 5th, 2d6 at 9th, 3d8 at 13th, 4d8 at 17th, 5d8 at 21st
system.damage: (1 - min(1, floor(@cl / 5)) + 2 * min(1, floor(@cl / 9)) - 2 * min(1, floor(@cl / 13)))d6 + (min(1, floor(@cl / 5)) - min(1, floor(@cl / 9)) + 3 * min(1, floor(@cl / 13)) + min(1, floor(@cl / 17)) + min(1, floor(@cl / 21)))d8
